info.title: treehopper — control app for Treehopper boards (list, GPIO, I2C, firmware
info.description: CLI front-end for the Treehopper control app: list boards and their state, toggle GPIO, scan I2C, and update firmware (fleet scan-and-flash). Built on the shared Periphery.Treehopper.Control core. Subsumes the standalone treehopper-update tool.

commands.name: all
commands.description: [--yes]               Fleet update: flash every board that needs it.

options.name: --file
options.description:
Firmware image to flash instead of the embedded one. Accepts a
.hex (Intel HEX) or .tfi/.efm8 (boot records); the format is
inferred from the extension and verified against the content.

options.name: --target-version
options.description: Target firmware version (decimal 274 or hex 0x0112). Gates updates.

options.name: --force
options.description: Flash regardless of version.

options.name: --json
options.description: Machine-readable output.

options.name: --seconds
options.description:
For 'watch': stop after n seconds (else runs until Ctrl+C).
-h, --help / --version   Help / tool version.
FIRMWARE IMAGE
Embedded image: none in this build.
A fleet build embeds it: dotnet publish ... -p:TreehopperFirmwareImage=<path> -p:TreehopperFirmwareVersion=<code>
EXIT CODES
0 ok / clean dry run   1 an operation failed   2 usage/refused   3 no firmware image   4 no board
